name: 回合回溯 / Turn Rewind
author: Yummn
description: Adds a mobile-friendly turn rewind bar to every combat. Up to 10 player-turn snapshots are kept in FIFO order. Long-press a snapshot segment to restore that turn; dragging the bar moves the whole panel and never selects a turn. No BaseLib dependency. The v0.1.30 build moves the panel below the relic/status strip, clears v0.111 CombatTurnState end-turn gates, restores the action synchronizer to PlayPhase, and avoids asynchronous Sandpit position callbacks during power restoration.
